messages:
tom: quick alert -- SkylinePay reported their live demo stream occasionally cuts off mid-event and the web client throws JSON.parse errors. demo was on hosted-us-east, model=red-2-small, route=/v1/streams.

maria: thanks, do we have the exact client error and any server traces?

skyline-frontend: client shows: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token { in JSON at position 0` after a burst of token output. They said it happens when they paste a long prompt.

jess: server logs (short):
```
2026-03-19T09:12:01Z INFO stream open conn=cn-9ab
2026-03-19T09:12:01Z INFO chunk write id=resp123 size=1024
2026-03-19T09:12:01Z WARN lb idle-close conn=cn-9ab cause=proxy-reset
2026-03-19T09:12:01Z ERROR stream aborted id=resp123 reason=socket_reset
```

priya: that lb reset looks like an intermediate proxy closing TCP right after a write. Could be their corp proxy or our edge idle/keepalive mismatch. What are our keepalive settings?

maria: default SSE heartbeat is `: keepalive` every 15s. but these disconnects happen within 10s of the write.

jess: another angle: we recently toggled `stream.writer_aggregation=enabled` in the router (deploy at 2026-03-19T08:50Z) to reduce syscalls. It coalesces small writes into bigger frames and may change flush timing. If the proxy has a max frame time it might cut mid-frame.

eng-deploy-bot: deploy notice: router feature flag `stream.writer_aggregation` set to true for default pool. No per-tenant override present.

tom: can we flip it for skylinepay only? POC needs quick fix.

jess: we can add a tenant override. Two options: 1) disable aggregation for their org; 2) add a post-write drain guarantee that appends `\n\n` and flushes per SSE event. Option 2 may be safer globally.

priya: skyline frontend code uses `new EventSource(url)` and then `JSON.parse(e.data)` per message. They don't stitch chunks. So we must ensure each SSE event delivered is a full JSON object and separated by the blank line boundary.

skyline-frontend: FYI their infra also has an NGHTTP2 proxy in front which sometimes merges sequential frames into one TCP write. That might produce `}{` boundaries if we don't include a newline gap.

maria: quick mitigation plan?

jess: I'll push tenant override to disable writer_aggregation for org=skylinepay. I'll also add router-side enforcement: guarantee `\n\n` between events and call socket.flush() after each completed event for tenants marked `poc=true`.

eng-deploy-bot: change enqueued: set routing.override.org.skylinepay.writer_aggregation=false; add explicit event terminator and immediate flush for tenants with tag `poc`. Will roll config in ~3m.

jess: rolled. skyline please re-run demo.

skyline-frontend: re-tested: much better. We still saw one reconnect during a large single response (~8s), but no parse errors. The reconnect happened and EventSource automatically reconnected; however the app wants a resume token to continue from the last partial answer.

priya: we support resume tokens in Hosted (header X-Resume-Stream) but the frontend needs to capture the last processed choice id. Recommend adding `data: {\"id\":\"<choice_id>\",\"chunk\":...}` and keep an ack/resume flow.

maria: skyline asked also about potential cost impact of per-event flushes vs aggregation. jess any rough numbers?

jess: for small test POC traffic it's negligible. At scale, disabling aggregation increases syscalls and network overhead: ballpark 2% CPU for router and 1% token throughput cost depending on batching. I'll document it for them.

priya: prod recommendations to give customer:
- use our SDK (handles partial frames + resume)
- implement client-side SSE boundary parsing (split on `\n\n` before JSON.parse)
- enable X-Resume-Stream to resume long responses
- configure proxy timeouts > 30s or use TCP keepalive shorter than proxy idle timers
- consider Dedicated if they need predictable high-throughput and to avoid shared edge behavior

maria: I've scheduled follow-up demo tomorrow 11:00 PST. Action items:
- eng (jess/priya): keep the tenant override for the POC and monitor metrics for 24h
- devex (maria): send a short integration note + minimal resilient client example and resume-token instructions to Skyline
- sales (tom): update POC notes and pricing note about perf overheads

tom: thanks all. Skyline appreciated the fast turnaround. I'll close once follow-up passes. :thumbsup:
